julesThoughtProcess: I selected Coral (#FF7F50) to contrast the industrial beams of the environment with the warmth of the human subjects and the organic resilience represented by the plant life.
storyPanel: End of shift in the upper canopy of the hydroponic gardens. The structural maintenance work is exhausting, and keeping the climate regulators running smoothly takes endless tinkering. Yet, looking out over the flourishing greens and taking a quiet moment to catch their breath together, the fatigue fades. They are building a sanctuary here, one girder at a time, ensuring a thriving future for everyone below.
